skill.name: minimax-music-playlist
skill.description: Create personalized playlists by building a music taste profile from Apple Music, Spotify exports, or manual input. The skill plans songs, generates MiniMax music and cover art, plays tracks, and saves feedback for future playlists.
skill.summary: Creates personalized MiniMax music playlists from listening history, manual taste input, and saved feedback.
skill.author: MiniMax-AI

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection or overt malicious exfiltration was found. Most static backtick findings are Markdown false positives, but the skill does instruct local music library access, home-directory searching, MusicBrainz lookups, external MiniMax CLI calls, and persistent taste-profile storage.

remediation.issue: Local listening data is collected through Apple Music queries, Spotify exports, and home-directory searches.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation for each data source before scanning, and offer a manual-input path by default.

remediation.issue: Setup instructions include global CLI installation and API-key authentication.
remediation.suggestion: Ask users to install and authenticate mmx outside the skill flow, and never request API keys in chat.

remediation.issue: Taste profiles, artist caches, playlist metadata, and feedback are persisted locally.
remediation.suggestion: Document retention, provide deletion steps, and store only aggregated profile data unless the user opts in.

remediation.issue: Artist enrichment can send listening-derived artist names to MusicBrainz.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the external lookup, add an offline-only mode, and cache only non-sensitive normalized artist metadata.

remediation.issue: The skill relies on agent-written scanning scripts created at runtime.
remediation.suggestion: Provide reviewed helper scripts or strict pseudocode that limits scanned paths, fields, and output files.

semantic_findings.title: Autonomous Local Listening Data Collection
semantic_findings.description: The skill collects listening data from local apps or exports and says the theme question is the only interactive step. Agent invocations can proceed without a separate confirmation for each data source.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow explicitly gathers music listening data and describes only one interactive theme question. This supports a clear consent and privacy risk, though the stated purpose is legitimate.

semantic_findings.title: Persistent Music Taste Profile
semantic_findings.description: The skill saves a taste profile, caches artist lookups, and updates feedback history. This creates persistent derived listening data that should have retention and deletion controls.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file paths and feedback update instructions directly show persistent storage of profile and cache data. The risk is privacy exposure rather than evidence of malicious intent.

semantic_findings.title: Unreviewed Dynamic Scanning Scripts
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells agents to write scanning and analysis scripts on the fly. This makes local data access harder to review and can exceed the intended scope if prompts are interpreted broadly.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly rely on agent-written Python scripts for scanning, but no fixed script is present to audit. The stdlib-only limit lowers severity but does not remove scope risk.

content.value_statement: Music listeners often need playlists that match their taste without manually choosing every song. This skill analyzes listening signals and generates MiniMax songs, covers, and playback-ready playlists.
actual_capabilities: Builds a taste profile from Apple Music, Spotify exports, or manual input.
Infers genres, moods, vocal preferences, tempo, language, and top artists.
Plans themed playlists with per-song style and language guidance.
Generates songs through mmx music and album art through mmx image.
Plays generated tracks and records playlist metadata and feedback.
limitations: Requires mmx CLI, authentication, and a local audio player for full generation and playback.
Spotify history needs a user-provided export, which can take several days to obtain.
Artist genre enrichment may use MusicBrainz when the local map has no match.
Generated music quality depends on prompt quality and MiniMax service availability.

use_cases.title: Personal listening sessions
use_cases.description: Create a playlist that matches recent listening habits and a chosen mood.

use_cases.title: Creative project soundtracks
use_cases.description: Generate themed songs and cover art for videos, streams, or mood boards.

use_cases.title: Automated playlist workflows
use_cases.description: Use saved taste profiles and feedback to generate new playlists with less setup.

prompt_templates.title: Create a starter playlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-song playlist based on my current music taste. Ask for any missing source before scanning.

prompt_templates.title: Use manual taste input
prompt_templates.prompt: I like Japanese city pop, calm piano, and female vocals. Generate a rainy evening playlist with cover art.

prompt_templates.title: Blend sources and theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my Apple Music library and Spotify export to create an upbeat commute playlist. Include varied tempos and languages.

prompt_templates.title: Refine from feedback
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request using saved profile history.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a new playlist using my saved profile, but avoid slow ballads and add more electronic textures than last time.

output_examples.input: Create a late night chill playlist.
output_examples.output: A profile summary, a five-song plan, generated tracks, cover art, playback paths, and a feedback prompt.

output_examples.input: Make something upbeat from my Spotify export.
output_examples.output: A source check, an upbeat playlist plan, MiniMax generation steps, and saved playlist metadata.

output_examples.input: I only want manual input. I like lo-fi, jazz, and soft vocals.
output_examples.output: A manual taste profile, a themed song list, matching cover guidance, and optional playback instructions.

best_practices: Confirm data sources before scanning local libraries or exports.
Use manual taste input when the user does not want local data access.
Review the playlist plan before starting long or paid generation runs.
anti_patterns: Do not scan broad home folders without user consent.
Do not paste API keys into shared chats or saved prompts.
Do not store raw listening histories when aggregated profile data is enough.

faq.question: Does this skill need my music history?
faq.answer: No. It can use manual taste input, but listening history improves personalization.

faq.question: Can it use Spotify?
faq.answer: Yes. Spotify requires a downloaded privacy export, and the skill can continue with other sources while you wait.

faq.question: Does it create new songs?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses mmx music generation when configured, rather than only recommending existing tracks.

faq.question: Can it make cover art?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate square album cover art through mmx image generation.

faq.question: Where are generated files saved?
faq.answer: By default, playlists go under ~/Music/minimax-gen/playlists/ on the user machine.

faq.question: Can I avoid network lookups?
faq.answer: Yes. Use manual input and the local artist map only, but genre coverage may be lower.
